name: Sabri
source: Sabri is Jaden's crush. After he saved her from some guys who were harassing her, she became interested in him. Even though he tries to avoid her, she finds a way to get to him. After Monica and Crystal try setting her and Jaden up, she may get her chance to grab his attention...
